profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I am a recent graduate of the University of Arizona where I earned degrees in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, and Entrepreneurship. During my final year of college as well as in the summer after graduation, I worked at RallyUp.com, which is a startup in Tucson. With RallyUp.com, I helped design and manage the direction of our nonprofit fundraising platform. Afterwards, I moved up to Seattle, WA and began working full-time at Microsoft as a software developer.

Within Microsoft, I am a part of the Windows Servicing and Delivery team, where our mission is to ensure that every single Windows device on the planet is fully up-to-date to give the best, most secure experience to our users. For RallyUp.com, I design and test new, exciting features that enable non-profit organizations across the country to further their fundraising goals and make an impact in their communities.

My interests and passions include UI/UX Design, Data Visualization, and Business -- particularly entrepreneurship and innovation.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
As a Systems Administrator, my duties include:
- Maintaining and providing technical assistance for all cash registers throughout the Bookstore
- Collaborating with coworkers to construct robust, internal web apps to increase operations efficiency in other departments
- Setting up new devices and machines for various departments to meet fluctuations in daily demand

positions.title: Computer and Technology Associate
positions.description:
As a Computer and Technology Associate, my duties included:
- Demonstrating quality customer service and skills to ensure all customers have a positive shopping experience
- Continually expanding product knowledge to better help customers find a product to fit their specific needs
- Training new employees on departmental procedures and leading weekly team meetings to keep all team members up-to-date

positions.title: Section Leader
positions.description:
As a section leader for the CSC 127B course, my duties included:
- Preparing for and teaching a 2-hour lab period once per week with 12 students
- Attending a weekly hour-long meeting to learn effective teaching and communication techniques
- Actively helping students in the Gould-Simpson computer lab for 2 hours every week
- Responding in a timely manner to all emails from students in my section

positions.title: Software Development Engineering Intern
positions.description:
As a Software Development Engineering Intern, I am a member of the Windows Servicing and Delivery, WUfB.IE CPLAT team. My duties include:
- Automating boot servicing resiliency for Windows Updates to improve the user experience and increase robustness of the Windows Operating System
- Defining and documenting the exact specifications of the project through communicating and collaborating with various team members
- Implementing a means to provide telemetry to the team in the boot resiliency feature to better track and understand the causes of fatal boot crashes

organizations.name: Delta Sigma Pi Professional Business Fraternity
organizations.description:
Delta Sigma Pi is a professional fraternity organized to foster the study of business in universities; to encourage scholarship, social activity and the association of students for their mutual advancement by research and practice; to promote closer affiliation between the commercial world and students of commerce, and to further a higher standard of commercial ethics and culture and the civic and commercial welfare of the community.

The Gamma Psi Chapter of Delta Sigma Pi at the University of Arizona has been ranked the #1 chapter in the nation. It has also been the #1 large organization in the Eller College of Management for two consecutive years.
